title: Orange cobwebs + Outline
description: Orange cobwebs and an outline for cleaner clips
body:
Orange cobwebs feature a bright, clean outline that stands out clearly in every fight. The vibrant color helps give clips a more energetic look while keeping the design simple and easy to recognize. Whether you're playing ranked matches or recording highlights, these cobwebs add a sharp, polished appearance that makes PvP feel smoother and more visually appealing overall.

🟠 Bright orange color that stands out
🎯 Clean outline for easy visibility
⚡ Smooth look during intense PvP fights
🎥 Great for clips, montages, and highlights
✨ Sharp, polished design
🧼 Simple style that fits any pack setup
🔥 Vibrant appearance without being distracting
